contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.child_policy_text: Child Policy - (Maximum Up to 02 Children): Age of 0-5 Free of Charge. Age of 6-11.99: USD 30 (Per kid/Per night on BB including extra bed), USD 45 (Per kid/Per night on HB including extra bed), USD 58 (Per kid/Per night on FB including extra bed) (Not Applicable for Triple Occupancy); USD 10 (Per kid/Per night on BB excluding extra bed), USD 25 (Per kid/Per night on HB excluding extra bed), USD 38 (Per kid/Per night on FB excluding extra bed). Baby cot on request can be provided free of charge. (Up to one cot per room)
contract.guide_policy_text: Guide/Tour leader Policy (Not Applicable from 20th December 2026 to 15th March 2027; only applicable at Jetwing Blue / Beach / Sea / Lake / St. Andrew's): Foreign Tour Leader – 20% discount on guest room rate for a Single room. 01 SGL room free of charge on the basis booked for minimum of 15 Pax up to 45 pax. If less the following rates apply in USD: BB – USD 70 | HB – USD 90 | FB – USD 105. Alternate accommodation in a full house; guaranteed guide accommodation is charged at the guest room rate. The hotel may double up / transfer guides. Driver Accommodation – Available.
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival. Hotel page – Peak Period Cancellation Policy (21st Dec 2026 – 10th Jan 2027 | Feb 2027): Cancellations Before 28 days of arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking and Cancellations within 28 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. This will apply to credit or non-credit agents.
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For last minute/short notice bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation. Hotel page – Peak Period Payment Policy (21st Dec 2026 – 10th Jan 2027 | Feb 2027): Upon confirmation, 50% of the total booking amount will be collected as payment in advance to secure the booking. This will be applied to both credit/non-credit agents.
contract.terms_text: JETWING ST. ANDREW'S (Nuwara Eliya): Superior (16 Rooms), Superior Heritage (24 rooms), Deluxe Attic (07 Rooms), Gem Suite (01 Rooms), Heritage Suite (04 Room). Single Reduction – USD 20 / Triple Supplement – USD 40 / Quadruple Supplement (Deluxe Attic only) – USD 60 (On BB). Single Reduction – USD 50 / Triple Supplement – USD 70 / Quadruple Supplement (Deluxe Attic only) – USD 120 (On HB). Single Reduction – USD 75 / Triple Supplement – USD 95 / Quadruple Supplement (Deluxe Attic only) – USD 170 (On FB). Special Offers – Early Bird Offers: Booked 75 days prior to arrival - 15% Discount; Booked 45 days prior to arrival - 10% Discount (Not Applicable for the stays during Super peak and month of February); Booked 75 days prior to arrival during Super peak and month of February - 10% Discount. Value Additions (Minimum 03 nights and above): High Tea (Once per stay); Organic Farm tour (Once per stay); Box of cookies on arrival; 10% Discount on beverages; 10% Discount on Laundry; Room Upgrade on availability. Driver Accommodation – Available. Reservations +94 522 222 445 / +94 707 092 481, resv.andrews@jetwinghotels.com. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserves the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | VALUE ADDITIONS POLICY: A maximum of 03 value adds can be used at each property. Experiences like Tours/Walks/Demonstrations etc. will be arranged in common groups depending on the occupancy for the day. Meal upgrade offers are valid only for FIT bookings. Food & Beverage discounts are not combinable with other promotions, offers, vouchers, outlets or seasonal deals. Food & Beverage discounts will not be applicable for liquor & tobacco. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Premium Hotels - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026-2027 (Revised).pdf" (20 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Currency "USD nett (Per room/Per night)", occupancy "Double Occupancy": the printed figure is the room at double occupancy; single/triple derived from the printed reductions/supplements (see row notes). Market clause "Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets" → DOM excluded. No contract date, gala dinner or rate code is printed. Early-bird / value-addition / meal-upgrade offers are in Offers (chosen by staff, never applied automatically). All five room names match the hotel's existing room types. Super peak here is 21 Dec 2026 – 10 Jan 2027 (first period ends 20 Dec). February is printed as its own period with the super-peak figures → kind peak. Peak cancellation and payment terms (hotel page and terms page agree: 21 Dec – 10 Jan & Feb 2027) applied to those dates. Supplier code 6-9-11-10975 (the hotel also carries 6-9-11-10751).
